bs7671Appendix4._about: BS 7671:2018 Appendix 4 data read by the BS 7671 cable sizer. Only tables carried here are sized; any other conductor / insulation / cable type / reference method is REFUSED rather than approximated. Per row: verified = It_1ph and It_3ph agree between two independent transcriptions (for most non-armoured columns the second is IEC 60364-5-52 Annex B, whose values BS 7671 adopts); mvVerified = the same for mV/A/m. A size with no mV/A/m carried cannot be selected, and the sizer says so. A result landing on a row with either flag false is reported VERIFY. The 2026-09-27 additions were read from public transcriptions only (sources per table); check every VERIFY row against the printed standard before issue.

ambientTemperatureFactors._table: 4B1 (Ca, ambient air, cables not buried). Only the 30 C reference and above are carried: below 30 C the sizer takes Ca = 1.00 (no uplift) instead of guessing the sub-30 C column. A temperature between two rows uses the HOTTER row.

groupingFactors._table: 4C1 (Cg). A circuit count between two rows uses the LARGER count (lower factor). Bunched = row 1 (bunched in air, on a surface, embedded or enclosed). SingleLayerWall = row 2 (single layer on a wall or floor, touching); no further reduction beyond 9. SingleLayerPerforatedTray = row 4, SingleLayerLadderCleats = row 5 (no further reduction beyond 9 either); the 2-circuit ladder factor 0.87 is BS source A plus three IEC 60364-5-52 B.52.17 transcriptions (FabriNeves, llosinskas, electrical-dev); the 0.88 once reported against it is the perforated-tray row.
